Why I am getting error: ‘strdup’ was not declared in this scope , I tried and add #include <string.h> but still getting error Can anyone please help me what is wrong in this code

events.body_html: Could you please indent your code.

First of all I suggest you to fix some problems with the code: 1.

delete [] filename;
filename=strdup(sn);

Okay your delete function suggests that your filename is a dynamic array which you never intialized. Also have you looked at what strdup returns, it returns a dynamic char, not an dynamic array. I would suggest you change:

delete [] filename;

to

free(filename);
